about_the_game:
Soulstream is a game about defying the endless Valley of Souls.

You will follow the words of the Master of Soulstream, whom you encounter within, and carry out the missions entrusted to you.

Can you reach the end of Soulstream and escape this place?

Game Features

"Endless Growth"
In Soulstream, death is not the end. Each death leaves behind a trace, becoming a beacon to guide you on your journey once more.

"Simple Controls"
Soulstream can be played entirely with the keyboard. Unlock certain features to enable auto-battle for a more hands-free experience.

"Background Play"
Too busy? Keep Soulstream running in a corner of your desktop and enjoy the game at your own pace. With an adaptive UI, the game supports any resolution.

"Varied Dungeons and Bosses"
Grow stronger without limits and take on a wide range of dungeons and powerful bosses!

Reach the end of your journey… and uncover the truth.
